why: scripts/derive_routing_turn_beta.py attaches a routing decision to an approach by its destination set. At the two freeway-interchange signals the set is contained in several approaches (W / offW / offE / E_SC107), and the tightest one wins: on v3b the four SC1004 west-side decisions 1124, 1126, 1138, 1140 all landed on SC1004 E_SC107 (1140 alone 4558 of its 4567), and 1117 (SC1001 west, W/offW/offE tie) was dropped. This table attaches each of them to the approaches whose vehicles actually pass it; the beta values still come from the decisions' relFlow (exogenous), this file only says WHERE they apply.

physical.1117: link 127 pos 228.9 = the single SC1001 west approach link; fed by FW_E off-ramp (link 2 -> c10481, OR_D_E), and via link 129 (c10777) by the FW_W off-ramp (OR_D_W) and the urban west input on link 32 (in_SC1001_W). Exits 30 (to_E_SC1002) / 38 (to_N_SC2002) / 39 (to_S_SC1003).
physical.1140: link 70 pos 67.9 (entries c10637 at 2.0 m, c10638 at 40.3 m, both upstream of the decision) -> c10776 -> 126 -> c10641 -> 71 (SC1004 W stop line); carries the FW_W off-ramp (OR_F_W, via 120) and urban west traffic.
physical.1126: connector 10643 (link 2 -> 126) pos 23.3: the FW_E off-ramp to SC1004 (OR_F_E); 1130 route 1 ends on it at 15.6 m, before the decision.
physical.1138: connector 10640 (link 69 -> 71 lane 4): urban traffic from the input on link 69 straight into the SC1004 W approach (in_SC1004_W).
physical.1124: link 66 = territory SC1004 'S' leg (in_SC1004_S); not measured (only 1:1:1 unit weight, no FZP watch on 66).

evidence.method: v3b no-control FZP s31/s41/s37, vehicles passing the decision's element at t >= 900 s; exit = first of the decision's route destination links reached afterwards (robust to 5 s frames skipping the 80 m link 71). Source: FW_W = passed link 26 (input 1099), FW_E = passed link 74 (input 1098), else urban. share order = dest_links order.
notes: 1140: FW_W and urban both follow relFlow 0.176/0.389/0.434 (0.15-0.18/0.38-0.40/0.42-0.47); 811-836 urban vehicles per seed leave link 70 onto the freeway (c10639, meter RM_C10639) on their own routes and are not SC1004 traffic.

1126: realized 0.38/0.39/0.21-0.25 against relFlow 1:1:1 - the exit to 67 (lane 1 of link 71 at 37.5 m, entered on lane 2) is under-served. Not used: beta stays exogenous (relFlow); revisit with the urban plant attribution work.

1138: realized 0.34-0.45/0.29-0.33/0.26-0.32 against 1:1:1, and 40-67 vehicles per seed reach none of the three exits. SC1004 W mixes 1140 (relFlow counts, 4558) with 1138 (unit weights, 3), so W is effectively 1140's split; the true urban mix is about 2/3 via link 70 and 1/3 via 10640 (s31 link-71 counts), i.e. W is off by <= 0.05 per movement. Left for the urban plant attribution work.
